Morning. 34 new since yesterday; 3 need you:
1. Northside Barbers wants to move Thursday's call to Friday 10:00. Drafted a yes.
2. The accountant needs last month's receipts by the 30th.
3. A customer asks about bulk pricing. Drafted a reply with your price list.
The other 31 are labelled: 18 newsletters, 9 receipts, 4 notifications.
Send the first one, and remind me about the receipts on Friday.
Sent the reply to Northside Barbers. I'll remind you about the receipts on Friday morning.
